## Key Services Offered
1. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Tally / Zoho / QuickBooks bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, bank reconciliation, profit & loss, balance sheet.
2. Auditing Services: Tax Audit under Section 44AB, statutory audit, internal audits.
3. Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing: ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4 (44AD/44ADA), corporate ITR-5/6 with deduction optimization.
4. GST Registration & Return Filing: New GSTIN registration, monthly GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B, ITC reconciliation, GSTR-9 annual returns.
5. Pvt Ltd & LLP Registration: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) incorporation, SPICe+, DIN, DSC, MOA & AOA.
6. Udyam MSME Registration: Official government MSME certification for subsidies, loans & tender exemptions.
7. Gumasta License (Shop & Establishment): BMC Maharashtra shop and establishment registration in Mumbai.
8. TDS & TCS Compliance: Section 194C, 194J, 194I, 194H, Form 24Q, 26Q and Form 16/16A generation.
9. PF Registration & Compliance: EPFO employer code, UAN generation, monthly ECR filing.
10. PF Withdrawal & Claims: Form 19, 10C, 31 claims, Date of Exit marking, rejection resolutions.
